data.orbiters_note: A real orbiter's passes over the landing spot: when it could see the lander. None of these orbiters offers to relay for a lander; this is geometry, not a service.
data.link_budget_note: Line of sight only: the lander's radio power and data rate are not published, so no data rate or link margin is given.

parts.note: Earth's rise and set at the lander carry the skyline's timing margin; the ± on each number is those edges in quadrature.
DSN masks are published to a tenth of a degree without a tolerance; edges they set carry no margin here.
When a station can hear, not whether it is booked: the DSN's load is not modelled. Booked passes entered by the team are listed.
